label: AI Code Review Tool
description: Automated PR review with AI explanations, suggestions, and code quality scoring — with built-in Stripe-backed subscription tiers

OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth client ID (canonical key consumed by @molecule/api-oauth-github)

OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: GitHub OAuth client secret (canonical key consumed by @molecule/api-oauth-github)

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: GitHub webhook secret for PR events. Live webhook delivery is BLOCKED until a real GitHub App is provisioned — local handler verifies HMAC against this value but tests use synthesised signatures.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_test_... in test mode)

STRIPE_AI_CODE_REVIEW_TOOL_PRO_MONTHLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro Monthly plan

STRIPE_AI_CODE_REVIEW_TOOL_PRO_YEARLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro Yearly plan

STRIPE_AI_CODE_REVIEW_TOOL_TEAM_MONTHLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Team Monthly plan

STRIPE_AI_CODE_REVIEW_TOOL_TEAM_YEARLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Team Yearly plan

MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Mailgun API key for transactional emails
